name: Live Scores
author: meviusisback
description: Live scores of your favorite teams in the Omarchy bar: logos and live score, FlashScore-style stats in the panel, upcoming matches, results and news. With no live match it shows a ball and the panel becomes settings.

barWidget.description: Live scores of favorite teams with stats, fixtures and news.

schema.label: Favorite teams
schema.description: Short names or ESPN ids, comma separated. The easy way is the Teams tab in the panel: search and press ＋. Old names (inter, milan, juventus…) and free words (como) keep working.

schema.label: Leagues
schema.description: Covered and searchable leagues: soccer/ita.1 (Serie A), soccer/eng.1 (Premier), soccer/esp.1 (LaLiga), soccer/ger.1 (Bundesliga), soccer/fra.1 (Ligue 1), soccer/ned.1 (Eredivisie), soccer/por.1 (Liga Portugal), soccer/uefa.champions, soccer/uefa.europa, soccer/uefa.euro (Euros), soccer/uefa.nations (Nations League with national teams), basketball/nba, basketball/euroleague, basketball/lba (Italian Serie A), hockey/nhl. Values without sport (ita.1…) count as soccer.
